basic_details.job_title: District Panchayat Korea Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 6 Accountant, Computer Programmer Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Panchayat Korea has announced 6 contractual vacancies for Computer Programmer (District Level) and Accountant (Janpad Level) posts under Advertisement No. 5153/ J.P./VB-G RAM G/ Stha./Contract Recruitment /2026. Eligible candidates must apply through the prescribed offline application process by sending the form through registered post or speed post to the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Korea, Baikunthpur, Chhattisgarh. The application period runs from 16 October 2026 to 2 November 2026 till 5:30 PM. Qualifications vary according to the post as specified in the official n

qualification.details: Computer Programmer (District Level): First division B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science / MCA / M.Sc. (Computer Science) / B.E. (IT), OR Data Entry Operator / Java / MS SQL / Oracle knowledge with preference. Accountant (Janpad Level): 55% marks in B.Com. (for ST and SC candidates, 50% marks in B.Com.), with second division in B.Com. for candidates from Sarguja and Bastar divisions. Age Limit: Minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years as per the notification rules. Chhattisgarh state domicile rules apply. important_instructions: Applicants must be native residents of Chhattisgarh. Applications must be submitted in the prescribed format available on the official website of District Korea. Applications sent directly without registered post will not be accepted. Any attempt to exert direct or indirect influence on the recruitment process will lead to disqualification. The contractual appointment is for one year, subject to annual performance appraisal and mutual agreement. Individuals removed from any post under Mahatma Gandhi NREGA for irregularities are ineligible.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent by registered post or speed post to the following address: Office of the Chief Executive Officer, Zilla Panchayat Koriya, Baikunthpur (Chhattisgarh) The envelope containing the application must clearly mention the name of the post applied for. Direct applications without registered post will not be accepted. Incomplete applications or applications received after the last date (02-11-2026 till 5:30 PM) will be automatically rejected. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications for each post.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Computer Programmer (District Level): First division B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science / MCA / M.Sc. (Computer Science) / B.E. (IT), OR Data Entry Operator / Java / MS SQL / Oracle knowledge with preference. Accountant (Janpad Level): 55% marks in B.Com. (for ST and SC candidates, 50% marks in B.Com.), with second division in B.Com. for candidates from Sarguja and Bastar divisions. Age Limit: Minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years as per the notification rules. Chhattisgarh state domicile rules apply. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of domicile certificate issued by a competent authority Self-attested copies of educational qualification marks sheets and degree certificates Valid employment exchange registration card Experience certificates issued by competent authority in government rural development schemes (specifying outward number, date, issuing officer name, contact number, and email ID) No Objection Certificate (NOC) from employer if employed in any institution or office Caste certificate issued by a competent authority

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on merit lists prepared according to specific criteria for each post: Computer Programmer: Merit list prepared based on percentage of marks obtained in minimum educational qualification (weightage given up to 70 marks), computer and practical test (15 marks), knowledge of data entry / Java / MS SQL / Oracle (5 marks), and work experience in government rural development schemes (minimum 2 years up to 5 marks, more than 2 years 10 marks). Accountant: Merit list prepared based on percentage of marks obtained in Higher Secondary (weightage up to 20 marks) and minimum educational qualification (weightage up to 50 marks), plus work experience in government rural development schemes (1 to 2 years: 5 marks, up to 5 years: 10 marks, more than 5 years: 15 marks), and computer practical test (15 marks). Candidates will be called for the practical / skill test in the ratio of 1:10 against vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applicants must be native residents of Chhattisgarh. Applications must be submitted in the prescribed format available on the official website of District Korea. Applications sent directly without registered post will not be accepted. Any attempt to exert direct or indirect influence on the recruitment process will lead to disqualification. The contractual appointment is for one year, subject to annual performance appraisal and mutual agreement. Individuals removed from any post under Mahatma Gandhi NREGA for irregularities are ineligible.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in District Panchayat Korea Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 contractual vacancies available for Computer Programmer and Accountant posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit offline applications by registered or speed post is 2 November 2026 till 5:30 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Computer Programmer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a first division B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science / MCA / M.Sc. (Computer Science) / B.E. (IT) or equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The age limit is minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years, with relaxations applicable as per Chhattisgarh government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary for the Accountant (Janpad Level) post is Rs. 23,350 / -.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their filled offline application form with required self-attested documents via registered post or speed post to the Chief Executive Officer, District Panchayat Korea.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a merit list calculated from educational qualifications, computer practical tests, experience in government rural development schemes, and document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Are these posts permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: These are contractual appointments for a period of one year, extendable based on performance appraisal.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Chhattisgarh apply?
faq.answer: No, applicants must be native residents of Chhattisgarh.
